motivation.text: You do not need to feel like it. Begin anyway and let the work change you.

discipline.text: Discipline is smaller than you think: one sock, one page, one call.

money.text: Save without display, spend without regret, wait without panic, and own what matters.

mindset.text: The setback did not erase the work; it only changed the next step.

fact.text: Your bones are constantly broken down and rebuilt throughout your life.

books.text: Systems beat goals because they shape daily behavior long after motivation fades.
books.credit: Idea from Atomic Habits by James Clear

stoic.text: The obstacle is not in the road; it is the road, if you keep moving.
